_doc: Singapore government procuring entities tiered by likelihood of issuing construction tenders that match CR13 (Waterproofing) / CR09 (Repair & Redec) / CW01 (General Building) scope. Tier 1 buyers are searched live each week; tier 2 are spot-checked when time allows; tier 3 / skip are screened out.

tier_1_high_frequency.name: HDB
tier_1_high_frequency.why: Block R&R, NRP/MUP, void deck A&A — core CW01/CR09 pipeline.

tier_1_high_frequency.name: LTA
tier_1_high_frequency.why: Depot R&R, station/tunnel waterproofing — heavy CR13/CW01.

tier_1_high_frequency.name: NParks
tier_1_high_frequency.why: Visitor centres, comfort stations, park buildings — CW01/CR09.

tier_1_high_frequency.name: NEA
tier_1_high_frequency.why: Hawker centres, market R&R — frequent CR09/CW01.

tier_1_high_frequency.name: PA
tier_1_high_frequency.why: Community clubs, RC centres — frequent A&A.

tier_1_high_frequency.name: SportSG
tier_1_high_frequency.why: Sports halls, swimming complexes — CR13 waterproofing critical.

tier_1_high_frequency.name: MOE
tier_1_high_frequency.why: School A&A, classroom block R&R — large CW01/CR09 pipeline.

tier_1_high_frequency.name: MOH
tier_1_high_frequency.why: Hospital and polyclinic R&R — high CR09 fit.

tier_1_high_frequency.name: TownCouncils
tier_1_high_frequency.full: All 17 town councils via EM Services / CPG / etc.
tier_1_high_frequency.why: Block waterproofing, repaint, void deck R&R — 200K-3M sweet spot.

tier_1_hospital_clusters.full: Ng Teng Fong General Hospital & Jurong Community Hospital

tier_2_medium_frequency.full: Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth
